title: Hildir's chests

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Hildir's chests are three quest-related items obtained as the rewards to each of the three parts of Hildir's Request. Each are large, heavy items which cannot be teleported through a Wood portal but can be teleported with a Portal stone.
Hildir has three types of chests: brass, silver and bronze. Each type of chest can only be found in one type of quest point of interest.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text:
• Hildir's Brass Chest is obtained from Brenna, the miniboss of the Smouldering Tombs.
• Hildir's Silver Chest is obtained from Geirrhafa, the miniboss of the Howling Caverns.
• Hildir's Bronze Chest is obtained from Zil, one of the two minibosses of the Sealed Tower.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text:
Returning one of each type of Hildir's chests to Hildir unlocks additional trades for decorative gear:
• Returning Hildir's brass chest unlocks trades for simple dresses, tunics, three types of headgear, and the Harvest clothes (Simple dress brown, Simple dress blue, Simple dress yellow, Simple tunic blue, Simple tunic red, Simple tunic yellow, Tied headscarf blue, Fur cap brown, Straw hat, Harvest tunic, and Harvest dress).
• Returning Hildir's silver chest unlocks trades for shawl dresses, cape tunics and three types of headgear (Shawl dress brown, Shawl dress blue, Shawl dress yellow, Cape tunic blue, Cape tunic red, Cape tunic yellow, Twisted headscarf green, Extravagant cap green and Tied headscarf yellow).
• Returning Hildir's bronze chest unlocks trades for beaded dresses, beaded tunics, three types of headgear and the Basic fireworks (Beaded dress brown, Beaded dress blue, Beaded dress yellow, Beaded tunic blue, Beaded tunic red, Beaded tunic yellow, Twisted headscarf red, Fur cap grey, Extravagant cap orange and Basic fireworks).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Hildir's chests are unusually large when dropped and float in water.
• Each of Hildir's chests are very heavy and cannot be teleported. Players will likely need to transport them by boat back to Hildir.
• Returning a chest to Hildir will enable new Events, which will cause the chest's respective miniboss and their minions to invade the player's base.
